claim_boundary: An outcome-informed development replay on four consumed 512-state rosters. A pass can authorize preregistration of one new disjoint static confirmation for the fixed R8/K48-single-exchange and conditional R16 K9/K144 method. It is not independent confirmation, trajectory authorization, capacity reclassification, action identity outside these rosters, stability, an all-queue theorem, or a physical multi-GPU result.

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail
decision_rule.R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_DEVELOPMENT_ACTION_ID: support passes but a final R16 action differs from its exact reference
decision_rule.R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_DEVELOPMENT_COMPUTE_F: support and action identity pass but charged LP, matrix, or candidate-evaluation work is not strictly below cold K4096 per roster or in aggregate
decision_rule.R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORT_F: the conditional R16 method fails a frozen physical-envelope support gate
decision_rule.R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_READY_FOR_NEW_INDEPEN: the fixed conditional method passes support, action identity, and strict charged-work gates on all four consumed rosters and in aggregate, every triggered rescue is score/canonical exact, and retained R8 evidence passes

method_contract.charged_work: sum every work field from the primary and every actually executed rescue; each bulk call also charges all structural pair checks it performs
method_contract.primary_method: frozen K9 canonical score-tie bulk-substitution selector
method_contract.r8_disposition: retain the four frozen passing R8 source outcomes without rerun
method_contract.reference_independence: neither primary, trigger, nor rescue reads the K4096 action, score, bound, or work value
method_contract.rescue_budget_rule: 16 lanes multiplied by the frozen nine-option model cardinality
method_contract.rescue_gate: every triggered rescue selection is score-exact and canonical-exact
method_contract.rescue_method: one separate fresh cold K144 canonical score-tie bulk-substitution call
method_contract.rescue_trigger: support_epsilon_limit minus primary epsilon is not greater than the shared score tolerance
method_contract.support_epsilon_limit_source: minimum effective_slack_eta over the frozen R16 v5 physical-envelope capacity rows (the load-0.95 row)

prohibited: changing the support limit, trigger tolerance, budgets, bulk rule, work accounting, loads, or consumed rosters after registration; reading K4096 inside the trigger or rescue; using these rosters as confirmation; new rosters, arrivals, trajectories, run-time RNG, server pulls, capacity reclassification, and paper edits

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol
